title: Token refresh waits 60 s on the phone (web 5 s or 15 s), and the two disagree on what a server error means
evidence: needs a look: the web half may be done by PR 1554 (6a2a0daa0, commit 034627a1a): dropbox.ts:346-356 marks only a 400 or 401 as 'reconnect', though a 5xx message still says 'please reconnect'; the refresh is bounded at TRANSFER_DEADLINE_MS.tokenRefresh 5 s (dropbox.ts:341). The phone half is open: OAuthClient.swift:43,50 URLSession.shared, no timeout on the token POST (:199-217), 400/401 = sign in again. ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/OAuthClient.swift:48,195-215 URLSession.shared 60 s, 400/401 = sign in again vs dropbox.ts:315 (5 s), drive.ts:334 (15 s, US-09 AC13h), web Dropbox treats any non-ok refresh as reconnect (dropbox.ts:320-323). No test. Fable ruled 2026-11-11: (R3) two PRs: the phone takes the web's bounds; the web stops treating a 5xx as reconnect, and that web half is sync class (adversary + Codex). iPhone survey 2026-11-11 (main fcc4ed9b) L5
